topic: Apollo footprints last millions of years
hook: Your footprints on the Moon could last millions of years.
title: Your Moon Footprints Could Last Millions of Years
description:
The Moon has no wind and no flowing water, so Apollo boot prints are still sitting in the dust. Only tiny space dust slowly wears them down. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Moon #Space
comment_prompt: Would you leave a footprint on the Moon? Yes or no
